subject: Move-in inventory report – C, 35 Upper St, London, N1 0PN
body:
Dear Smith,

I moved into C, 35 Upper St, London, N1 0PN today and have attached a PDF inventory report recording the condition of the property at move-in. It includes photos and timestamps for every issue listed below.

Please treat this report as the record of the property's condition at the start of my tenancy, so that none of these existing issues are charged to me from my deposit at the end of the tenancy.

Issues noted

Kitchen:
- Wall cabinet door bottom trim: wood-effect trim worn, with the finish peeling and scuffed along its length (cosmetic, already present).
- Wall cabinet door bottom trim (corner): worn and chipped finish on the corner of another door's trim (cosmetic, already present).
- Wall cabinet underside trim / pelmet: a section appears broken or missing, leaving a gap (cosmetic, already present).
- Cable under wall cabinet: loose cable draped exposed along the underside of the trim, not clipped or concealed (landlord to repair).
- Worktop to wall tile joint by sink: dark gap where sealant is missing or has failed (landlord to repair).
- Washing machine door seal: black mould or dirt build-up on the rubber seal (responsibility unclear – see below).
- Washing machine front panel: torn sticker and adhesive residue (cosmetic, already present).

Repairs requested

Please could you arrange for the loose cable under the wall cabinet to be properly secured and for the sealant between the worktop and wall tiles by the sink to be repaired. I would be grateful if you could confirm a date for this work.

For the washing machine door seal, please could you let me know in writing who you consider responsible for dealing with this.

For reference

- Existing cosmetic wear (not caused by me): Shelter – Deposit deductions for damage and missing items: https://england.shelter.org.uk/housing_advice/tenancy_deposits/what_can_your_landlord_deduct_from_your_deposit/damage_and_missing_items
- Landlord repairs (electrical wiring; sinks and their pipes and drains), and items depending on the tenancy agreement: GOV.UK – Private renting: repairs: https://www.gov.uk/private-renting/repairs

Please could you confirm receipt of this email and the attached report in writing. I will keep a copy of the report with my deposit protection paperwork.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,

Anant Shah
